title: 20. Exercises: Classification Algorithms — practice set
summary: 2 short exercise sets: Classification Algorithms — practice set, Naive Bayes.
objectives: Practise classification algorithms without looking at the lessons
Write each solution as a small script and check edge cases

sections.title: Decision Trees
sections.body:
### **Exercise 1: Basic Decision Tree ⭐☆☆☆☆**
Train tree on iris dataset, visualize, extract rules, save model.

### **Exercise 2: Hyperparameter Tuning ⭐⭐☆☆☆**
GridSearch over max_depth, min_samples_split, min_samples_leaf. Find optimal combination.

### **Exercise 3: Pruning Analysis ⭐⭐⭐☆☆**
Compare pre-pruning (max_depth) vs post-pruning (ccp_alpha). Which prevents overfitting better?

### **Exercise 4: Production Deployment ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆**
Build loan approval system: explain decisions, extract rules, handle imbalanced data.

### **Exercise 5: Tree Instability Demo ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Show how small data changes create completely different trees. Propose solution (hint: ensembles).
